description: Brazilian card acquiring API — merchants, cards-on-file, 3DS, PIX, banking, pricing.
name: io.github.codespar/mcp-rinne

environmentVariables.description: API key sent as x-api-key header on every request. Organization-level keys see all merchants; merchant-level keys are scoped to one merchant.
environmentVariables.name: RINNE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Defaults to sandbox (https://api-sandbox.rinne.com.br/core). Set to "false" for production (https://api.rinne.com.br/core).
environmentVariables.name: RINNE_SANDBOX

environmentVariables.description: Login identifier for the access-management tools (API Keys, Roles, Permissions, org Users, Zipcode lookup), which reject x-api-key by design and require a JWT session.
environmentVariables.name: RINNE_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Company to select after JWT login, for accounts with access to multiple companies.
environmentVariables.name: RINNE_COMPANY_ID
